target_workflow: SEO Content Agent Beta.v14 - Worker (sandbox clone first)
least_risky_insertion: After Normalize Run Output, before Format Run Pipeline (or Format-as-candidate then gate before Send).
preserve_untouched: Webhook / Route Command core (except optional strict NL flag detection if chartered)
TZ Strict Cleanup / Strict Cleanup / Strict Risk Scanner as-is for v1 (freeze expansion)
keep_pipeline_through: Run SEO Strategy / Extract SEO Strategy
Text + Repair + Strict Cleanup + Strict Risk Scanner
Build SEOQA / Run SEO QA / Factcheck

nodes_to_add.name: Build Final Public Payload
nodes_to_add.purpose: Canonical public_payload + internal_raw + repairable_fields; apply Strategy hide policy; apply QA/factcheck include policy; detect NL strict trigger into effective_strict_surface_gate

nodes_to_add.name: Final Surface Strict Scan
nodes_to_add.purpose: Scan all public surfaces via central marker SOT; emit residuals[] + clean/dirty

nodes_to_add.name: Build Strict Repair Payload
nodes_to_add.purpose: OpenRouter payload with public surfaces + residual list + marker SOT + repair contract

nodes_to_add.name: Extract Strict Surface Repair
nodes_to_add.purpose: Parse structured JSON repair; merge only affected repairable fields; preserve task_id/metadata

nodes_to_add.name: Final Surface Strict Re-Scan
nodes_to_add.purpose: Re-use same scanner SOT on repaired public payload

nodes_to_add.name: Format Strict Reject Message
nodes_to_add.purpose: Short diagnostic only: STRICT QA REJECT — output blocked; task_id; residual summary

nodes_to_modify.name: Format Run Pipeline
nodes_to_modify.change: Consume approved public_payload only; stop dumping raw JSON.stringify(seoStrategy.table_strategy); render Strategy public summary/h1 bullets if present; include QA/factcheck summary only when public_payload says include_summary=true; prefer scanning already done — Format must not invent new unscanned text
nodes_to_modify.risk: medium — large existing jsCode; prefer minimal edits + call into shared SOT helpers duplicated carefully in sandbox design

nodes_to_modify.name: Prepare Memory Row Run
nodes_to_modify.change: Persist memory_status + sanitized_payload + optional raw_internal_ref fields; never write approved_clean for dirty
nodes_to_modify.risk: medium — Sheets column contract must be designed in sandbox design

nodes_to_modify.name: Route Command / flag parse (optional small)
nodes_to_modify.change: If brief matches NL 'не используй слова' / 'запрещённые слова', set effective_strict_surface_gate=true even when flags.strict=false

clean_path: existing: Take First Item → … → Send Telegram Run → … → Prepare Memory Row Run (approved_clean) → Append Memory Run
dirty_repair_path: IF Repaired Clean (true) → Format Run Pipeline → send → memory repair_attempted_clean
IF Repaired Clean (false) → Format Strict Reject Message → send diagnostic → close lock → memory blocked_dirty

scope_guards.FU03-SCOPE-01: no PC-07 Close Lock mapping changes
scope_guards.FU03-SCOPE-03: no production mutation in proposal/design stages
